Subject: Hearthwell MSA redlines + signer identity proofing

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for sending the redlines yesterday. Legal ran through the MSA and put together a short list of execution questions we need closed before we can pull the trigger on DocuSign:

- Can Redwood accept notarized signature as a fallback if one of our execs needs notarization?
- We need an auditable chain of custody for the final clean copy (PDF + signature audit). Can you confirm how Redwood publishes the signed artifact and whether it includes the signing IP and timestamp?
- For delegated signers, Hearthwell requires a POA or an internal signatory matrix. Marcus will attach the delegation table.

Also, for DocuSign routing: are you able to set the envelope to require ID verification for the first signer and standard email validation for subsequent signers? If so, please outline the steps so our IT/legal can sign off.

I've attached our redline (Hearthwell_MSA_redline_v3.pdf). We'd like to close execution by EOD Monday if possible.

Appreciate a quick confirmation and a proposed swap of who owns which piece of the checklist.

Best,
Olivia
Corporate Paralegal — Hearthwell Health
legal@hearthwell.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Olivia Mendez <olivia@hearthwell.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hearthwell MSA redlines + signer identity proofing

Olivia —

Thanks for the thorough notes and the redline. Quick answers inline below; full runbook attached.

- Notarized fallback: yes. We accept notarized signatures as a secondary path. Our post-signature publishing can include notarization metadata if you provide the notarized PDF back to us; we'll ingest it into the artifact bundle.

- Signed artifact & audit trail: Redwood publishes a signed PDF plus a JSON audit log that contains signer email, signing IP, timestamp (UTC), and certificate chain for the DocuSign envelope. We can also publish an S3 link (pre-signed) to the envelope evidence bundle for 30 days by default; extended retention is available as an add-on.

- Delegated signers: happy to consume your POA or a signatory matrix. Marcus — please send the delegation spreadsheet and the name/email of the primary signer to slot into the envelope.

- ID verification: DocuSign ID verification can be enforced for the first signer. We will configure the envelope so that signer #1 must pass ID verification (phone or ID check) and subsequent signers use email authentication. If you prefer multi-factor for all signers we can flip that too — will add notes in the runbook.

Next steps (proposal):
1) Marcus sends delegation table + primary signer email (Hearthwell) — owner: Hearthwell (Marcus) — target: today 12pm PT
2) Redwood (me + Laura) prepare envelope and run a dry-run with a Redwood test account — owner: Redwood — target: today 4pm PT
3) Hearthwell legal confirms ID verification profile — owner: Hearthwell — target: today 6pm PT
4) Execute live envelope — owner: joint — target: Mon EOD

I've attached a short internal runbook (Execution_Identity_Runbook.txt) describing the DocuSign profile we'll use and how to retrieve the audit bundle. Laura — looping you for verification of the audit export flow. Priyom — please stage the Order Form clean copy (OrderForm_CleanCopy_20260820.pdf) for the envelope.

Let me know if any of these targets are unrealistic.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Thanks Marcus/Olivia — all clear on the delegation table and the Tara primary signer. Confirming the following final points so we can schedule the envelope: 

- Single envelope: yes, we'll package the MSA + Order Form in one DocuSign envelope so the audit trail is consolidated. The evidence bundle will include both PDFs plus the signing audit JSON.
- ID verification: we'll set DocuSign ID verification for Tara as signer #1 (email + ID check). If the verification fails, we'll pause the envelope and notify you; you can then instruct us to proceed with notarized fallback.
- Delivery of clean copy: once the envelope completes, Redwood will publish: signed_combined_MSA_OrderForm.pdf and signing_audit_HW-2026-0921.json to a pre-signed S3 link and we'll email the bundle to legal@hearthwell.com.
- Retention: default 30-day presigned link; if you need 90 days, we'll add that to the order and include cost delta in the confirmation.

Plan: we will prepare the envelope and run the dry-run at 4pm PT today. If all good, we'll schedule the live send for Monday 9am PT to Tara. Please confirm if Monday 9am works for Hearthwell.

Thanks,
